svg.aria-label: Quirón, an AI humanizer that measures its own work: an AI-written draft hands over to its rewrite, and on the meter five measures of the text (long words, word length, nominalizations, lists of three, plain words) move from the AI side into the human band, 13 of 23 becoming 23 of 23.
svg.text: An agent skill that strips the AI slop, then checks the text against human writing.
